svg.title: From color spans to emit sweeps
svg.desc: Mobile explanation of the current libsixel node heuristic: nearby same-color runs become span nodes, the nodes are ordered by start and end columns, and a greedy scan packs them into non-overlapping emit sweeps separated by carriage returns.
svg.text: From color spans to emit sweeps
Start at the first nonzero sx.
Bridge at most nine zero columns.
Split before a gap of ten; mx is exclusive.
A node can contain internal ? columns.
2 Order nodes by sx, then mx
The numbered list is the emitter's scan order.
Take sx ≥ cursor in the current sweep.
Reset with $ and repeat until none remain.
deterministic greedy heuristic, not an exhaustive optimum
